title: Going on holiday
description: A dialogue lesson on the present perfect tense (have/has + past participle). Carol and Tom are having lunch; they offer Sam lunch and coffee, but he has already had both. In the living room they are packing their suitcases because they are going to leave tomorrow to have a holiday. Sam says he has already had his holiday this year — he stayed at home. Workbook practice covers comprehension questions and a fill-in exercise with home/school/holiday phrases. Grammar exercises build present-perfect dialogues and rewrite 'want to have' sentences as 'haven't had' explanations.
answer_note: Lesson listening question (Where did Sam go for his holiday this year) is a suggested model answer based on the dialogue. Practice A (comprehension) 8 items are taken from the supplied Lesson 83 key (img/key-080-085.jpg). Practice B (fill in home/school/holiday phrases) 9 blanks are taken from the same key. Grammar I (make up dialogues) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-10 are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer pages 513-514). Grammar II (give correct explanations) items 1a and 2a are printed examples; the remaining 14 items are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer page 514). No external sources were used.

lesson.text:
Listen then answer this question. Where did Sam go for his holiday this year?
听录音，然后回答问题。今年萨姆去了什么地方度假？
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording, then answer: Where did Sam go for his holiday this year?

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：你好，萨姆。进来吧。

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: Hi, Sam. We're having lunch. Do you want to have lunch with us?
lines.translation: 汤姆：你好，萨姆。我们正在吃午饭。你跟我们一起吃午饭好吗？

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: No, thank you, Tom. I've already had lunch. I had lunch at half past twelve.
lines.translation: 萨姆：不，汤姆，谢谢。我已经吃过午饭了。我在12点半吃的。

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Have a cup of coffee then.
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：那么喝杯咖啡吧。

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: I've just had a cup, thank you. I had one after my lunch.
lines.translation: 萨姆：我刚喝了一杯，谢谢。我是在饭后喝的。

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: Let's go into the living room, Carol. We can have our coffee there.
lines.translation: 汤姆：我们到客厅里去吧，卡罗尔。我们可以那里喝咖啡。

lines.speaker: CAROL
lines.text: Excuse the mess, Sam. This room's very untidy. We're packing our suitcases. We're going to leave tomorrow. Tom and I are going to have a holiday.
lines.translation: 卡罗尔：屋子很乱，请原谅，萨姆。房间里乱七八糟。我们正在收拾行李箱。明天我们就要走了。我和汤姆准备去度假。

lines.speaker: TOM
lines.text: When are you going to have a holiday, Sam?
lines.translation: 汤姆：萨姆，你准备什么时候去度假？

lines.speaker: SAM
lines.text: I don't know. I've already had my holiday this year.
lines.translation: 萨姆：我不知道。今年我巳度过假了。

lesson.title: Listening — answer the question
lesson.instruction: Listen then answer this question. Where did Sam go for his holiday this year? 听录音，然后回答问题。今年萨姆去了什么地方度假？
lesson.translation: Answer the question according to the dialogue.

questions.prompt: Where did Sam go for his holiday this year?

items.title: Present perfect tense
items.text: 在英语中，现在完成时主要用于以下两种情况：(1)表示在过去不确定的时间里发生的并与现在有着某种联系的动作；(2)表示开始于过去并持续到现在的动作。本课中萨姆的3句话属于第一种情况，正是因为他吃了饭、喝过了咖啡、也休过假，因此他谢绝了汤姆的邀请，并表示今年巳无可能再次休假。现在完成时是由 have 的现在式加上过去分词组成。规则动词的过去分词与过去式相同，而不规则动词的过去分词则无统一的规律可言。从本课起不规则动词后还将列出其过去分词的拼写和读音。

items.title: I've already had lunch.
items.text: 注意 already 的语序。在一般情况下，它跟在助动词后面。

items.title: Excuse the mess.
items.text: 意思是："乱七八糟，请原谅。"

items.title: have a holiday
items.text: 度假。have 在不同词组中，意思不同。如：have lunch, 吃午饭；have a cup of coffee, 喝杯咖啡。

items.title: stay at home
items.text: 呆在家里。注意名词 home 之前不加任何冠词。在诸如 go home, arrive home 的短语中，home 是副词。

lesson.text:
参考译文
卡罗尔：你好，萨姆。进来吧。
汤姆：你好，萨姆。我们正在吃午饭，你跟我们一起吃午饭好吗？
萨姆：不，汤姆，谢谢。我已经吃过饭了。我在12点半吃的。
卡罗尔：那么喝杯咖啡吧。
萨姆：我刚喝了一杯，谢谢。我是在饭后喝的。
汤姆：我们到客厅里去吧，卡罗尔。我们可以在那里喝咖啡。
卡罗尔：屋子很乱，请原谅，萨姆。房间里乱七八糟。我们正在收拾行李箱。明天我们就要走了。我和汤姆准备去度假。
萨姆：你们真幸运！
汤姆：萨姆，你准备什么时候去度假？
萨姆：我不知道。今年我巳度过假了。
卡罗尔：你去哪儿了？
萨姆：我呆在家里了！

practice.title: A — Comprehension
practice.instruction: Look at the dialogue on Students' Book page 169 and answer these questions. 参见学生用书第169页上的对话，然后回答以下问题。
practice.translation: Answer each comprehension question about the lesson dialogue.
practice.context: Answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 83 key (img/key-080-085.jpg).

questions.prompt: 1. Does Sam want to have lunch with Carol and Tom?
2. Why doesn't he want to have lunch with them?
questions.answer: Because he has already had lunch.

questions.prompt: 3. When did he have lunch?
questions.answer: He had lunch at half past twelve.

questions.prompt: 4. Has he had a cup of coffee?
5. When was that?
questions.answer: He had a cup (of coffee) after his lunch.

questions.prompt: 6. What are Carol and Tom packing?
7. What are they going to do tomorrow?
questions.answer: They're going to leave tomorrow. (They're going to have a holiday.)

questions.prompt: 8. Has Tom already had his holiday this year?

practice.title: B — Vocabulary (home / school / holiday phrases)
practice.instruction:
Look at these phrases with the words home, school and holiday. Then put them in the blanks in the sentences. 请看这些含有 home, school 和 holiday 的词组，然后填空。

Phrases: arrive home / come home / get home / go home / be at home / stay at home / be at school / go to school / be / go on holiday / have a holiday
practice.translation: Choose the correct phrase for each blank from the word bank.
practice.context: Answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 83 key (img/key-080-085.jpg).

questions.prompt: 1. Sam arrived ______ from work at 8 o'clock yesterday evening. (home / at home)
2. We were ______ until 5.30 yesterday. (to school / at school)
3. 'Please come ______ early this evening,' she said. (home / at home)
4. They're lucky! They've already had ______ this year. (on holiday / a holiday)
5. My father always comes ______ before he goes out again. (home / at home)
6. I'm going to stay ______ tomorrow. (at home / to home)
7. Children in that country go ______ at 8 in the morning. (at school / to school)
8. My friends are ______ in Australia. (holiday / on holiday)
9. What time did you get ______ last Saturday evening? (home / at home)

grammar.title: I. Make up dialogues according to the example. 仿照例句编写对话。
grammar.instruction:
Make up dialogues according to the example. 仿照例句编写对话。
Example: 1. you/have a haircut/last Thursday → When are you going to have a haircut? I have already had a haircut. When did you have a haircut? I had a haircut last Thursday.
grammar.translation: Make a present-perfect dialogue from each set of cues, following the example pattern.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=513
grammar.context: Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-10 each require four lines of dialogue. Answers are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer pages 513-514).

questions.prompt: 1. you / have a haircut / last Thursday
questions.answer: When are you going to have a haircut? / I have already had a haircut. / When did you have a haircut? / I had a haircut last Thursday.

questions.prompt: 2. he / have a swim / two days ago
questions.answer: When is he going to have a swim? / He has already had a swim. / When did he have a swim? / He had a swim two days ago.

questions.prompt: 3. you / have a holiday in the country / last month
questions.answer: When are you going to have a holiday in the country? / I/We have already had a holiday in the country. / When did you have a holiday in the country? / I/We had a holiday in the country last month.

questions.prompt: 4. she / have an English lesson / this morning
questions.answer: When is she going to have an English lesson? / She has already had an English lesson. / When did she have an English lesson? / She had an English lesson this morning.

questions.prompt: 5. they / have a meal in the restaurant / last week
questions.answer: When are they going to have a meal in the restaurant? / They have already had a meal in the restaurant. / When did they have a meal in the restaurant? / They had a meal in the restaurant last week.

questions.prompt: 6. you / have lunch / at twelve o'clock
questions.answer: When are you going to have lunch? / I/We have already had lunch. / When did you have lunch? / I/We had lunch at twelve o'clock.

questions.prompt: 7. he / have a drink / half an hour ago
questions.answer: When is he going to have a drink? / He has already had a drink. / When did he have a drink? / He had a drink half an hour ago.

questions.prompt: 8. they / have a party / on July 15th
questions.answer: When are they going to have a party? / They have already had a party. / When did they have a party? / They had a party on July 15th.

questions.prompt: 9. she / have a bath / at seven this morning
questions.answer: When is she going to have a bath? / She has already had a bath. / When did she have a bath? / She had a bath at seven this morning.

questions.prompt: 10. you / have dinner / an hour ago
questions.answer: When are you going to have dinner? / I/We have already had dinner. / When did you have dinner? / I/We had dinner an hour ago.

grammar.title: II. Give correct explanations for the requests according to the examples. 仿照例句正确解释下列句子。
grammar.instruction:
Give correct explanations for the requests according to the examples. 仿照例句正确解释下列句子。
Example 1a: I want to have a holiday. → I haven't had a holiday.
Example 2a: I want to have some wine. → I haven't had any wine.
grammar.translation: Rewrite each 'want to have' sentence as a negative present-perfect explanation, following the examples.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=514
grammar.context: Items 1a and 2a are printed examples (not editable). The remaining 14 items are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer page 514).

questions.prompt: 1. a. I want to have a holiday.
b. They want to have a party.
c. He wants to have a swim in the sea.
questions.answer: He hasn't had a swim in the sea.

questions.prompt: d. I want to have an orange.
e. He wants to have a haircut.
f. She wants to have a meal in the restaurant.
questions.answer: She hasn't had a meal in the restaurant.

questions.prompt: g. I want to have a talk with you.
questions.answer: I haven't had a talk with you.

questions.prompt: h. She wants to have a glass of milk.
questions.answer: She hasn't had a glass of milk.

questions.prompt: 2. a. I want to have some wine.
b. She wants to have some cheese.
c. We want to have some lamb.
d. He wants to have some fruit.
e. They want to have some whisky.
f. He wants to have some beer.
g. I want to have some butter.
h. They want to have some meat.
